proposedOverrides.summary: A northwestern Anatolian kingdom whose royal alliances, cities and coinage outlasted this atlas’s narrow third-century BCE snapshot.

batchIdentityNotes.decision: Exact indexed kingdom only; no shared aliases. Imported300 to 200BCEpolygon is a narrowKocaeli strip and cannot represent fullkingdom or Romanprovince. EarlierXenophon and latertomb/Pliny are explicitly contextual, not falsely dated domestic evidence. Named adjacentRoman/Pergamene records remain separate.
